details.description: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking is Alibaba's Qwen team's reasoning-enhanced edition of its 30B-A3B vision-language Mixture-of-Experts model, with 31 billion total parameters across 128 experts, 8 of which activate per token, per its Hugging Face model card and config. It was released October 4, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license alongside a separate non-reasoning 'Instruct' edition of the same size, per the Qwen3-VL GitHub README. The model card describes the 'Thinking' edition as delivering deeper visual perception and reasoning, particularly on STEM and math tasks, and it shares the family's native 256,000-token context window (expandable to 1 million tokens via YaRN), Interleaved-MRoPE positional embeddings and DeepStack vision-transformer feature fusion.
advantages: Reasoning-enhanced 'Thinking' edition documented as delivering deeper visual perception and reasoning than the Instruct edition, particularly on STEM and math tasks (Qwen model card).
Supports OCR in 32 languages, up from 19 in the prior Qwen-VL generation (Qwen model card).
Documented visual agent capability: recognizes on-screen elements and invokes tools to operate PC and mobile GUIs (Qwen model card).
Includes 2D and 3D spatial grounding for visual reasoning and embodied-AI tasks (Qwen model card).
Native 256,000-token context window, expandable to 1 million tokens via YaRN (Qwen model card).
disadvantages: The maker's benchmark tables for this model are published only as images, so no independently verifiable numeric benchmark scores could be confirmed from the pages opened.
use_cases: Multimodal reasoning tasks requiring step-by-step visual analysis, such as STEM and math problems presented as images
Visual agent workflows that operate GUIs by recognizing on-screen elements and invoking tools
Document and OCR understanding across many languages
Long-context and hours-long video understanding with temporal grounding
Complex visual question answering requiring causal or logical analysis

sources.title: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Thinking - Fireworks AI

notes: Catalog facts list this route's modality as text-only (no image_input), but Qwen documents Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking as a vision-language model that accepts image and video input, and Fireworks' own listing for this model shows image input enabled; kept the catalog's modality per instructions and flag the conflict here. Catalog's 262,144 max input/output tokens match the maker's stated 256K native context. Benchmark tables on the model card and GitHub README are images, so no numeric evaluation scores could be verified from the pages opened; the model's own page did not state an exact active-parameter count in prose, but this model's own config.json (added to sources) confirms the 128-expert/8-active-per-token MoE architecture directly.
